items.evidence: Log lines 2-193 show 18 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells with one tip.
Log shows 1 uL colony A1..H12 to matching pcr wells (e.g. lines 196-197) and 1 uL primer to matching wells (lines 1156-1157) with the p20.
Each colony and each primer transfer has its own pick up/drop tip (e.g. lines 195-204, 1155-1158); the master mix single tip goes only into empty wells.
The code calls protocol.comment with the seal and the full program: 98°C 30 s; 30x [98°C 10 s, 60°C 30 s, 72°C 30 s]; 72°C 2 min; hold 4°C.
The steps follow the task order, including 3x mix after the colony template, and the metadata and comments describe only what the code does.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the run log for 18 uL master mix into all 96 wells and for 1 uL colony template and 1 uL primer per matching well, each with a fresh tip. The seal and thermocycling program is recorded in a comment, and the comments and metadata are accurate, so every item passes.
